data.narrative:
Strider Technologies is a Series C-stage defense and security company that has raised $117M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 13 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage private companies, supplemented by 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Top private peers include Quantum-Systems, Helsing, Anduril Industries, Shield AI, and Neros, with valuations ranging from $300M to $18.0B.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $117M total raised as a proxy for current valuation, implying $199M. Peer-median analysis across the 13 comparable companies yields a median valuation of $2.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $18.0B. The wide peer range reflects significant heterogeneity in stage advancement and commercial traction within the defense-tech cohort.

Triangulating these methods produces a valuation range of $169M (conservative floor) to $2.5B (upper bound), with a median of $1.2B. The stage-progression method floors the range conservatively; the peer-median approach dominates due to its larger sample size and stage-relevant coverage. Key uncertainties center on revenue trajectory, customer concentration risk, and the degree to which Strider's technology and market position align with the top-quartile performers (Helsing, Saronic, Quantum-Systems) versus the broader cohort. Further due diligence on contract pipeline and customer diversification would refine this range materially.
